title: U.S. beneficial-ownership reversal and BOI perimeter — rev0362 claim packet
verified_premises: Domestic entities and their beneficial owners are locator-bound as exempt from current FinCEN BOI reporting.
Covered reporting company perimeter is narrowed to foreign-formed entities registered to do business in U.S. jurisdictions.
U.S.-person beneficial-owner reporting gap is separately bound, including for foreign reporting companies.
Interim-final-rule posture remains a currentness qualifier.
unverified_decisive_premises: Final rule and litigation status not yet bound after interim rule.
Alternative rails such as state registries, tax forms, procurement disclosures, CDD, and property records are not yet audited.
Beneficial-owner verification, accuracy, and data-access implementation remain unproved.
Trust/legal-arrangement visibility must still be reconciled with the FATF comparator and domestic trust/entity practices.
next_edges_to_build: Bind final-rule/litigation status or explicit absence of final rule.
Build alternative-rail map for domestic beneficial-owner visibility after FinCEN narrowing.
Bind access/verification implementation for users of BOI data under the narrowed rule.
certification_boundary: This packet is claim-level evidence migration, not case certification. Certification requires decisive premises, contrary evidence, implementation/currentness checks, and recertification triggers.
